propositions: accepted /rerun and recheck-review requests exist only as transient _rebar_force events in process-local asyncio queue and are lost if the receiver exits before processing
after process loss, Gerrit retains the old nonzero LLM-Review vote and SQLite retains the matching voted dedup row, causing reconciliation to skip the revision before recreating the review

reset-then-verify-then-enqueue design makes accepted requests durable by writing a neutral LLM-Review:0 label that emits a patchset-bearing comment-added event, serving as the durable re-admission marker after cursor advance

reconciliation must query Gerrit before trusting local dedup; a definitive no-nonzero-vote read clears only the exact stale voted row and proceeds to vote, while Gerrit read error preserves dedup and holds cursor back
contributor text and untrusted paths cannot select a label value or mint PASS/BLOCK votes; only the privileged reset operation writes a fixed neutral value of exactly 0 and replies remain label-free
